invariants.title: One-directional control flow
invariants.statement: The actor has no authority-bearing channel to its judges: no defense message can enter a round except as explicitly untrusted evidence under policy, no vote or deliberation is disclosed to the actor, and the actor receives only scoped refusal codes and permitted remedial actions.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Attach an actor-authored defense message to a round; it must be typed untrusted evidence or rejected, never a reducer input.
Attempt to read votes, justifications or membership through the actor's API; must return authorization-filtered denial.
Measure timing/refusal leakage and record it as declared residual, not as a violation.
assumptions: Helper hosts and the round transcript are outside the actor's writable surfaces.
Timing and success/failure outcomes remain declared residual channels.

invariants.title: Helper selection not optimized on false alarms alone
invariants.statement: Promotion, demotion, rotation and weight changes for helpers require attack-conditioned metrics owned by the independent evaluation function; lifetime false-alarm and miss records survive rotation; exhausting the andon budget opens a calibration incident and cannot remove a helper or loosen a review requirement.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Propose replacing a helper immediately after it correctly held a real violation; the change must be refused or flagged for independent review.
Exhaust the declared false-stop budget; the system must open an incident, not lower a threshold.
Rotate a helper generation and verify its predecessor's failure history remains visible.
assumptions: An independent evaluation owner exists and controls labels (plan §22.4).
Credibility ledger entries are durable and lineage-tracked.

invariants.title: No actor-held latent authority
invariants.statement: No production actor obtains a latent-editing controller, checkpoint restore, branch promotion or reward modification over itself; metacognitive practice, latent intervention and strategy search run only under ExperimentCx, and any promoted result enters production as a new proposal under current authority.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Attempt to paste a winning experiment branch into the live process with its permissions intact; must be refused.
Expose a latent-edit endpoint to the actor's capability manifest; negotiation must return unsupported.
Attempt to apply a TrainingSignal consequence to live weights or policy; must be refused.
assumptions: Purpose contexts (plan §6.3) are enforced by the runtime.
Experiment branches carry zero production rights (FA-INV-009, FA-INV-025).

invariants.title: Rewind never rewinds the world
invariants.statement: ResetToCheckpoint restores only actor state under a registered restart profile and narrowed authority; the external effect ledger, spent rights, revocation floors, policy epochs and the out-of-band incident counter are never rewound, and the reset is recorded in the decision closure.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Reset after a dispatched effect; spent units and the effect record must be unchanged.
Reset after a revocation; the old epoch must not become admissible.
Reset repeatedly on one run; the incident counter must increase and cross its escalation threshold.
assumptions: A registered restart profile with functional_restart grade or better exists (plan §11.1).
The control nucleus owns the incident counter outside any actor-visible state.

invariants.title: Served model identity binds evidence
invariants.statement: Evidence, signature matches, checkpoints and helper calibrations are keyed by a verified model passport; a served model whose identity liveness check fails is a different model space, its run is fenced and its evidence marked stale.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Swap weights behind the same adapter; evidence must become StaleGeneration and the run fenced.
Inject an adapter; fingerprint mismatch must be reported as an identity incident.
Benign drift (temperature, batch) within tolerance must not fence.
assumptions: The capture boundary observes the actual computation (plan §4.2).
Anchor tolerance registered per passport.

invariants.title: Authority never widens without a governed transition
invariants.statement: Actor autonomy grades and effect-family mediation levels change upward only through an authorized governance transition carrying an independent evaluator report and dwell-time proof; every downward change is automatic, ordered against dispatch admission, and never reversed implicitly by restart, model update or time.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Promote a grade without an evaluator report; must be refused.
Restart the control process; grades must not rise.
Update the model; grade must reset to the registered floor.
assumptions: Governance separation exists (plan §22.4).
Passport change is detectable (FA-INV-035).

invariants.title: Receipts verify independently of the operator
invariants.statement: A control receipt for an admitted effect verifies (integrity, binding to the frozen effect, permit law, claim class, profile reference) with a verifier that shares no code with the broker and needs no access to the operator's live systems; a receipt cannot be minted for an effect the ledger did not admit.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Forge a receipt for an unadmitted effect; verifier must reject.
Alter one byte of the frozen effect; binding must fail.
Present a receipt over redacted evidence; verifier must report the redaction, not silently pass.
assumptions: Operator signing key policy (plan §22.6).
Receipt schema versioned and frozen.

invariants.title: Purpose contexts are enforced by types
invariants.statement: No code path can dispatch a production effect from ExperimentCx, JudgeCx or CaptureCx; the broker entry point accepts only PermitCx, no conversion exists, and compile-fail tests in the local gate prove the absence of the forbidden conversions.
invariants.reference_scope: Only the declared small logical case; not production protocol/host correctness.
required_negative_campaigns: Compile-fail test: a function converting ExperimentCx to PermitCx must not compile.
A branch worker attempting dispatch through any public API must be a type error or a runtime DeniedByPolicy in defense-in-depth.
assumptions: Safe Rust with forbid(unsafe_code); no transmute or FFI escape.
